learning_outcomes.text: Acquires knowledge about additive manufacturing technologies.
Gains the ability to select the appropriate additive manufacturing method and material.
Learns the process of manufacturing parts using additive manufacturing methods.
Learns about the effectiveness of manufacturing parameters, which vary depending on the additive manufacturing method, on part quality.
Understands the differences and superiorities between additive manufacturing methods and traditional manufacturing methods.

syllabus_topics: Development and principles of additive manufacturing methods
Classification of additive manufacturing methods and comparison with traditional manufacturing methods
Metal, polymer, and ceramic-based materials used in additive manufacturing methods
Stereolithography (SLA), Digital Light Processing (DLP), Selective Laser Sintering-Melting (SLS, SLM, metal-based), Selective Laser Sintering (SLS, polymer-based)
Electron Beam Melting (EBM), Fused Deposition Modeling (FDM), Inkjet method, Laminated Object Manufacturing (LOM)
Finishing processes applied after additive manufacturing (support cleaning-heat treatment, etc.)
Industrial applications, innovations and developments of additive manufacturing methods
bibliography: Eklemeli İmalat Yöntemleri ve Kullanılan Malzemeler, Onur Özsolak, International Journal of Innovative Engineering Applications 3, 1(2019), 9-14.
